program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const mass = inputs.mass; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(time, 2 * apexTime)); const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; let motionState = "Rising"; if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "At the top"; } else if (t > apexTime) { motionState = "Falling"; } if (height <= 0 && t > 0.1) { motionState = "Back at launch height"; } if (t === 0) { motionState = "Ready to toss"; } const maxH = Math.max(2.2, apexHeight * 1.3); const pxPerM = 280 / maxH; const originY = 330; const ballY = originY - height * pxPerM; const ballX = 180; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 40, w: 290, h: 360, title: "Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 90, y: 330, length: 280, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: maxH, ticks: [0, maxH/2, maxH], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: ballX + 20, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: ballX - 25, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(ballX + 45, ballY - 25, ["v: " + velocity.toFixed(2) + " m/s", "a: " + acceleration.toFixed(1) + " m/s^2", "Fg: " + force.toFixed(1) + " N"], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 330, y: 40, w: 290, h: 360, title: "Velocity over time", state: "v = u - gt" })); const points = []; const steps = 20; for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) { const st = (i / steps) * (2 * apexTime); const sv = launchSpeed - gravity * st; const sx = 360 + (st / (2 * apexTime)) * 230; const sy = 220 - (sv / 5.5) * 90; points.push([sx, sy]); } objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 350, y: 70, w: 250, h: 220, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 2 * apexTime, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: points.map(p => ({ x: (p[0] - 360) / 230 * (2 * apexTime), y: 5.5 - (p[1] - 130) / 180 * 11 }) ) }] })); const curX = 360 + (t / (2 * apexTime)) * 230; const curY = 220 - (velocity / 5.5) * 90; objects.push(sdk.circle("marker.vt", curX, curY, 8, { role: "observed" })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 360, 340, "Slope a = -g", { align: "start" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, mass, apexTime, apexHeight, height, velocity, acceleration, force } }; }
